title: The Star Wars Concert
description: The STAR WARS Concert poster by John Alvin (card 78) is sought after for both its humor and its scarcity. This black and white, unattributed charcoal and pencil sketch (front) shows another concept: Obi-Wan Kenobi directing a STAR WARS orchestra. The pencil sketch by John Solil (back) is one of the earliest STAR WARS poster concepts in the Skywalker Ranch archives.
